title: Finite Q3 unitary-history tail Holder corollary
question: For unitary Q3 character histories, can the inverse-free sandwiched Holder envelope remove all history-side L4 factors and leave only one cutoff-tail fourth-moment factor?

mathematical_interface.state: Let rho be a normalized finite Gibbs density and S=rho^(1/4).
mathematical_interface.unitary_history: A_t=U_t A_0 U_t^* with A_0 unitary, hence ||A_t||_infinity=1.
mathematical_interface.normalization: Schatten-4 Holder gives ||S A_t||_4 and ||A_t S||_4 at most ||S||_4=(Tr rho)^(1/4)=1.
mathematical_interface.corollary: N2_sym([W,A_t]) <= ||S W||_4 + ||W S||_4; for W=W^* the two tail legs have equal fourth powers, so the bound is 2||S W||_4.
mathematical_interface.qft_role: The direct Duhamel history integrand requires only a local tail fourth-moment bound after this corollary; it does not by itself prove that bound or a common dynamics.

lean_crosscheck.role: R347 checks the exact nonnegative scalar corollary and rational fixture; finite Schatten inequalities and all limits remain Python evidence.

adversarial_review.check: The history-side reduction is applied only after checking A_t^*A_t=I and A_tA_t^*=I in every finite row.
The identity ||rho^(1/4)||_4=1 uses the explicitly normalized Gibbs trace; no unnormalized partition function is hidden.
The cutoff tail is symmetrized before its left/right fourth-leg equality is tested; no commutation with rho is assumed.
The factors retain their order S W, A S, S A and W S, so noncommutativity is not discarded.
Only the positive quarter root of rho is formed; the corollary has no modular inverse or spectral-floor dependence.
The history-side factor is uniform for normalized unitary histories, but the tail fourth-leg values are only finite beta/volume/cutoff diagnostics.
The Q3 histories use declared finite oscillator dimensions and are not promoted to the unbounded CCR domain.
The independent lane reconstructs the Q3 matrices, unitary checks, tail roots and sandwich norms without importing the primary lane.
R347 certifies scalar assembly only; it does not formalize matrix Schatten Holder or thermodynamic passage.
A local tail fourth-moment theorem, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

qft_interface.closed: For the declared finite Q3 character histories, the Holder integrand can be bounded by a single tail fourth-leg factor, uniformly over time/interpolation/orientation once the tail and state are fixed.
qft_interface.open: A source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform bound for the tail fourth-leg factor, unbounded common-core continuity, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary C6/Q3 finite evidence only; no heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

It does not prove the required tail moment uniformity, modular-domain transfer, direct Cauchy convergence, exhaustion independence, common alpha, Hamiltonian-OS identification, a GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
